bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, or by phone or WhatsApp on +852 2710 1093. Special requests (a high chair, a round table, dishes to pre-order) can be added to the booking.
cancellation: Cancel at least 24 hours ahead; a late cancellation or no-show may be charged to the card given when booking. Tables are held for 10 minutes.
groups: For 13 or more, phone the restaurant.
duration: Lunch tables are booked for 90 minutes.
